description: Network microsegmentation: environments whose machines are labelled by application and environment, with east-west traffic seen first, then limited by policy, and a way to quarantine a compromised machine.

types.labelled_vm: Machines labelled by application, environment and role
types.app_policy: Policies that allow only the traffic an application needs
types.isolation_policy: Policies that keep whole environments apart
types.quarantine_policy: Policies that isolate a machine suspected of compromise
types.flow_view: Views of the traffic actually flowing between machines
